title: Dimas Roger Widianto
descriptionHtml:
Hey! I’m Dimas Roger, a Full Stack Developer who loves building stuff from pixel to database. When I’m not wrestling with bugs, I’m probably experimenting with a new framework, working on a random side project, or drinking coffee while reading docs (yes, I actually do that). 😉

I was learn coding at 2020 when the pandemic covid was starting, my first coding language that i've been mastering is Vue and React. so after that i start working on software house when i was 18 💀

After entering the professional world, I started learning to become a Backend Dev as well. starting from liking the PHP and eventually I learned other languages such as Node JS and Golang. ⭐️
